card.name: Because of / result in linking words
card.fires_on: The small words "of" after "because" and "in" after "result(ed)", right before a stated consequence or risk. Also "See" at the start of a pointer to full prescribing information.

modes.label: Because of
modes.description: The word "of" right after "because", before a risk or reason.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors (MAOI) : Because<< of>> the risk of serotonin syndrome, do not

modes.label: Result in
modes.description: The word "in" after "result" or "resulted", before an outcome.
modes.example: Introduction of somatropin treatment may result<< in>> inhibition of 11βHSD

modes.label: See full information
modes.description: The word "See" opening a cross-reference to full prescribing information.
modes.example: Adjust thereafter based on GH and/or IGF-1 levels.<< See>> full prescribing information for titration regimen.

card.plain: It marks little linking words like "of" in "because of" and "in" in "result in", just before a cause or outcome is named.
